entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Produce a replacement dialogue portrait spritesheet for a Pokemon Showdown fan game, using the attached official artwork as the precise character-design reference. Transparent PNG, landscape exactly 2:1 with TWO EQUAL SQUARE CELLS side by side. Each cell has a waist-up portrait of the SAME character in precisely the same pose, scale, framing, hair and costume. LEFT: neutral conversational expression. RIGHT: subtle friendly recognition/approval. Adapt the reference to clean confident anime linework and restrained flat cel shading, matching the official reference's character identity and color palette. Accurate anatomy. Entire head, shoulders and visible hands inside each cell, transparent margins and gutter, no text, no scenery, no extra people. Do not turn all characters into a generic handsome template. Atticus / 秋明, Team Star. Faithfully retain the magenta hood with dripping edges, black lower-face mask, small light green fringe, lime green shoulder details, purple clothing, crossed pale cloth straps. Preserve his slender ninja silhouette. Close to frontal, head slightly turned toward viewer's left as in reference, upper body at a slight diagonal, one hand raised in a small controlled two-finger ninja gesture near shoulder. MOST IMPORTANT: one anatomically correct exposed eye on the viewer's LEFT side of the face, above the masked cheek, with the other eye entirely concealed under the opaque magenta hood on viewer's RIGHT. The visible eye must sit on the correct side of the hidden nose bridge, not float in the middle of the forehead or resemble a reversed eye. No extra eye shapes. Nose and mouth remain concealed by the black mask in BOTH frames. Approval conveyed solely by softening the visible eye and eyebrow. Keep the exact hood/eye occlusion, silhouette and color boundaries consistent across both frames.
